pictures.scene: Peter Paul Rubens, King David Playing the Harp — the old king in profile with his white hair and long beard, a heavy jewelled chain over his ermine mantle, his face lifted and his hands up among the strings of the harp, for the choirmaster of David, in the LORD I take refuge
pictures.name: pd_rubens_king_david_harp

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, The Watzmann — the great snow peak standing clear and white against the blue, the dark wooded ridge below it and in the front a tumble of bare boulders with one small fir growing out of the rock, how then can you say to me, flee like a bird to your mountain
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_der_watzmann

pictures.scene: Lucas Cranach the Elder, The Stag Hunt of the Elector — the huntsmen standing in the bushes with their crossbows wound and levelled, taking aim across the water at the driven stags swimming the river with the hounds after them, for behold the wicked bend their bows, they set their arrow on the string
pictures.name: pd_cranach_the_stag_hunt_of_the_elector

pictures.scene: Thomas Cole, The Course of Empire Desolation — one broken Corinthian column left standing over the dead city with a bird's nest in its capital and ivy climbing halfway up the shaft, the long ruined colonnades and the fallen bridge arches lying quiet in the water behind it, to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart, if the foundations are destroyed
pictures.name: pd_cole_the_course_of_empire_desolation

pictures.scene: Pieter Saenredam, Interior of Saint Bavo in Haarlem — the whitewashed pillars going up into the vaulting, the tall windows standing pale and the painted boards and the brass chandelier hanging in the aisle, one small figure alone away down the empty stone floor, what can the righteous do, the LORD is in His holy temple
pictures.name: pd_saenredam_interior_of_saint_bavo_haarlem

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, God Enthroned — the enthroned figure looking straight out of the picture in a jewelled triple crown and a deep red mantle clasped with a great pearl and sapphire brooch, the gold rays of His halo and the carved gold lettering standing in the arch behind His head, the LORD is on His heavenly throne, His eyes are watching closely
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_enthroned

pictures.scene: Johannes Vermeer, Woman Holding a Balance — the woman in her white hood and blue fur-lined jacket standing quiet at the table with the empty scales held level between her fingers, the pearls and the gold lying out of their box in the light, and the dark Last Judgment hanging on the wall just behind her head, they examine the sons of men, the LORD tests the righteous and the wicked
pictures.name: pd_vermeer_balance

pictures.scene: John Martin, The Destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah — the whole sky over the city turned into one falling sheet of fire, the towers and walls going down into the blaze under it, and one small white figure standing out on the dark ridge in front of it all, His soul hates the lover of violence, on the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur
pictures.name: pd_martin_the_destruction_of_sodom_and_gomorrah

pictures.scene: Carl Haag, Danger in the Desert — the bedouin standing with his back to us in a heavy fringed cloak and headcloth, his spear held out level and his face turned to watch the bare glaring plain, his loaded camel couched in the sand at his side, a scorching wind will be their portion, for the LORD is righteous
pictures.name: pd_haag_danger_in_the_desert

pictures.scene: Christ Pantocrator, Daphni — the great gold mosaic face looking straight down out of the dome, the cross set in the halo behind His head, His dark hair and beard laid in line upon line of stone and the jewelled gospel book held up against His blue robe, He loves justice, the upright will see His face
pictures.name: pd_daphni_christ_pantocrator

lines.text: For the choirmaster. Of David.
In the LORD I take refuge.
How then can you say to me:
“Flee like a bird to your mountain!
For behold, the wicked bend their bows.
They set their arrow on the string
to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
If the foundations are destroyed,
what can the righteous do?”
The LORD is in His holy temple;
the LORD is on His heavenly throne.
His eyes are watching closely;
they examine the sons of men.
The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked;
His soul hates the lover of violence.
On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur;
a scorching wind will be their portion.
For the LORD is righteous;
He loves justice.
The upright will see His face.
